product_metadata.title: Set of 4 Grapefruit Spoons and 1 Grapefruit Knife, Stainless Steel, Serrated Edges (Silver-5pcs)
features: Grapefruit Serrated 4 Scoops and Knife Set.
The serrated edge of the spoon makes it easy to separate the peels
Easily accommodates right- and left-handed users.
Serrated grapefruit knife with wooden handle.
description: Set of 4 grapefruit spoons 6.1" long and an 8.27" long grapefruit knife. The serrations on the sides make it a handy tool for preparing grapefruit. The jagged edge on the grapefruit spoon easily cuts through the citrus membrane, allowing you to easily remove all the fruit. Made of high quality stainless steel.
